name: Holiday Lights
lore: The road winds into a snowy wood lit up for the winter holidays: twinkling trees and wrapped presents, snowmen and snow angels, penguins, foxes and polar bear cubs, cozy mittens and a crackling cabin, and a clock ticking down to a new year that everyone can join.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; lane C's Holiday Lights (winter, Christmas and New Year, mostly close portraits per Peter's 10/13 rule; small-figure scenes, speckled fireworks, red smears and look-alikes left out), 26 picks and 17 spares (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/16-holiday-lights/README.md, picks-full.json, workspace 2822569: 5 dropped on lane D's phase-1 bake and pre-read, hl021 Owl in snow too easy, hl048 Countdown, hl040b Gift wrap and hl020 Lantern unclear, hl026b Sweater dog a maroon patch under the mouth); lane C edited many of them (a tighter crop, the plain background split into a navy sky band and a snow-white ground band; the edit field, ops in edits.json; the file <id>e.png). Kind painting, shade on, converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). The 43 manifest lines are lane C's, whole; lane D filled only the empty url with the licence row's source in Dino Valley's words. The folder keeps lane C's slug (16); as installed it is Land 12 in the factory's numbering (era 20) and Zen World 13.
eggNote: Eggs on the reused sheets' painted side-quest spur tips (tools/map-plan-v7.md section 6; the land has no side quests): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots (19 at (328,694) (98,536); 20 at (541,949) (639,455)), each repeat its own pair, as the plan gives them. Kinds for the snowy wood: owls, glints (ornaments), wisps (lights), a woodpile (a yule fire) and embers.

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.
